 BLAST SLAM IX: The Opening Match
 Dota 2 /
 Coverage / 20 November 2026 — 01:00 
 BLAST SLAM IX is underway! OG will be NAVI 's first opponents at the tournament. The best of 3 match is scheduled to begin on November 20 at 15:00 CET.
 Unlike NAVI , who secured their place through the qualifiers, OG received a direct invitation to the event. At the previous edition of the series, BLAST SLAM VIII , the team finished in 7th–8th place.
 GROUP A 
 NAVI 
 OG 
 PlayTime 
 Yandex 
 The current OG lineup features Natsumi , Topson , SSS , OneJey and Skem . The team made changes to its roster ahead of the new season but has yet to achieve any major results.
 A win in the opening group-stage match could be a crucial step towards the playoffs and give the team a significant boost. Tune in to the broadcast and cheer on the Born to Win !
 Go NAVI !
